THEMES.ocean: Calm blue/indigo. Safe default; suits retrieval, search, NLP, general ML.
THEMES.sunset: Warm orange/rose. Suits generative models, diffusion, creativity, images.
THEMES.forest: Green/teal. Suits training, optimization, RL, evolution, efficiency (e.g. LoRA).
THEMES.graphite: Neutral slate with violet accent. Academic, theory-heavy or math-heavy papers.
THEMES.berry: Fuchsia/plum. Playful and vivid; suits multimodal, vision-language, creative agents.
THEMES.sand: Warm neutral with a terracotta accent. Calm and editorial; suits ethics, history, evaluation.

FONT_PAIRINGS.modern: Inter + JetBrains Mono. Clean product feel; default for most topics.
FONT_PAIRINGS.editorial: Fraunces serif headings + Inter body. Essay-like, good for theory and history.
FONT_PAIRINGS.technical: Space Grotesk + IBM Plex Mono. Engineering/systems feel, architecture-heavy papers.
FONT_PAIRINGS.friendly: Nunito + Fira Code. Rounded and approachable, best for absolute beginners.

HEADING_STYLES.gradient-banner: Full-width gradient header per step. Bold, energetic.
HEADING_STYLES.underline-accent: Large heading with an accent underline. Calm, article-like.
HEADING_STYLES.numbered-badge: Circular step number badge beside the heading. Structured, tutorial-like.

LAYOUTS.article: DEFAULT. One scrolling page with a sticky stage nav; stages build on each other but the reader can jump around. Right for almost every paper and concept.
LAYOUTS.pipeline: Overview flowchart + one locked page per step with Prev/Next. Only when the topic itself is a strict data-processing sequence the reader should walk in order.

LEVELS.beginner: No prior ML knowledge; everyday analogies, minimal math.
LEVELS.student: Knows basic ML/linear algebra; some formulas with intuition.
LEVELS.practitioner: Works with ML; precise terms, real numbers, trade-offs.

INTERACTIVITY.reading: Mostly reading: clear explanation with a few visuals where they help most. Cheapest
INTERACTIVITY.balanced: Balanced: the usual mix of explanation and interactive parts
INTERACTIVITY.hands-on: Hands-on: as many sliders, charts and experiments as the topic allows. Costs more

EXTRAS.depth: Deeper explanation (costs more): a longer explanation of each section, with the why, the intuition and the edge cases
EXTRAS.examples: Worked examples: step-by-step worked examples for the sections
EXTRAS.rephrase: Same explanation in different wording: each section explained again another way
EXTRAS.search: Search the web with AI: searches the web about a section when you click its button, with sources
EXTRAS.auto: Let this mode decide: worked examples where they help, plus the web search button

LEVEL_CHOICES.auto: Auto: Jev picks the level from the topic
LEVEL_CHOICES.student: Intermediate: knows basic ML and linear algebra
LEVEL_CHOICES.practitioner: Advanced: works with ML; precise terms and real numbers

MATH_DEPTH.intuition: Key formulas, each with an intuitive reading of every symbol.
MATH_DEPTH.none: Almost no formulas; ideas carried by words, pictures and numbers.
MATH_DEPTH.derivations: Full formulas and the steps between them; for readers who want the maths.

APPROACH.intuition: Intuition first: the core idea in plain words, then the details.
APPROACH.example: Example first: open each idea with a concrete case, then generalise.
APPROACH.problem: Problem first: what goes wrong without the idea, then how it fixes it.
APPROACH.story: Story: how the idea evolved, each step fixing the previous one's limits.
APPROACH.compare: Compare: the idea set against the alternatives it competes with.

GOAL.understand: Understand how and why it works.
GOAL.implement: Implement or use it: concrete steps, settings and pitfalls.
GOAL.judge: Judge the claims: evidence, results, limitations.
GOAL.revise: Revise for an exam: definitions, key facts and practice questions.

ANALOGIES.few: A few everyday analogies where an idea is abstract.
ANALOGIES.none: No analogies; the reader prefers the real mechanism.
ANALOGIES.many: Many everyday analogies; the reader is new to the field.

TONE.neutral: Clear and neutral, like a good textbook.
TONE.friendly: Warm and encouraging, like a patient tutor.
TONE.academic: Precise and formal, like a survey paper.

TOPIC_AREA.architecture: Model architectures and their building blocks.
TOPIC_AREA.evaluation: Evaluation, safety, ethics and societal impact.

TEXT_SIZES.small: Smaller text for dense, technical pages.
TEXT_SIZES.large: Larger text for beginners and easy reading.

DENSITY.compact: Compact spacing for long, dense pages.

EMPHASIS.both: Highlight key sentences and colour key terms.
EMPHASIS.bold: Bold only; no highlights or coloured terms.

EMPHASIS_AMOUNT.normal: Emphasis on the most important points of each stage.
EMPHASIS_AMOUNT.sparing: Very little emphasis: only the single most important point per stage.
